The '''Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies - New Caledonia''' (ISEE-NC) ({{langx|fr|link=no|italics=set|Institut de la Statistique et des Études Économiques-Nouvelle-Calédonie}}) is a public institution in [[New Caledonia]] that collects, produces and analyzes [[statistics|statistical information]].
